picks.game: Los Angeles Angels vs Pittsburgh Pirates
picks.rationale: The Pittsburgh Pirates are in significantly better recent form, winning four of their last five games, while the Los Angeles Angels have lost nine of their last ten. The Angels' offense is struggling, ranking last in wOBA and 29th in xwOBA over the past 30 days. While Angels starter Ryan Johnson has shown recent improvement, Pirates starter Jared Jones possesses better underlying metrics (3.84 xERA, 3.83 xFIP) than his 4.83 ERA suggests, indicating potential for a strong outing. The Pirates are at home and are well-positioned to win by multiple runs against a struggling Angels team.

picks.game: Boston Red Sox vs Baltimore Orioles
picks.rationale: There is significant reverse line movement towards the Orioles, indicating sharp money is backing them despite public sentiment favoring the Red Sox. The Orioles are highly motivated, being in a crucial playoff race and sitting just 1.5 games out of the third Wild Card spot. Orioles starter Shane Baz has been pitching effectively, allowing three earned runs or fewer in four of his last five starts, while Red Sox starter Ranger Suarez has struggled recently with a 5.01 ERA in his last seven appearances. The Red Sox are also dealing with key injuries, having just lost All-Stars Willson Contreras and Ceddanne Rafaela, while the Orioles benefit from the addition of lefty-masher Luis Robert Jr. to their lineup.

The Miami Marlins hold a strong home record of 42-27, and their starting pitcher, Janson Junk, has been in excellent form recently, allowing two earned runs or fewer in four straight starts and boasting a 3.62 ERA at home. Conversely, Chicago Cubs starter Shota Imanaga has struggled significantly, giving up 11 home runs since the All-Star break and 9 in August alone. The Marlins' Heriberto Hernandez has exceptional splits against left-handed pitching, with 10 home runs and a .556 slugging percentage, which bodes well against Imanaga. Furthermore, the Cubs' bullpen has a concerning 7.11 ERA over their last 10 games, providing another edge for Miami.

picks.game: San Francisco Giants vs New York Mets
picks.rationale: New York Mets starter Nolan McLean is in dominant form, boasting a 3.06 ERA and 1.124 WHIP with 172 strikeouts, and has allowed one earned run or fewer in four of his last five starts. The San Francisco Giants are starting rookie Matt Wilkinson, who has a limited and less impressive track record with a 4.63 ERA and 4.6 K/9 in his three career starts. The Giants' offense has been inconsistent, ranking 23rd in MLB in runs scored, while the Mets' lineup features strong hitters like Juan Soto. The Mets are coming off a high-scoring 10-4 victory and should have confidence at home to win by multiple runs.

Athletics starter Kade Morris has been performing poorly, holding a 9.82 ERA and having given up 9 earned runs in just 4 innings pitched on the road this season. He also struggles significantly against left-handed batters, and the Mariners are expected to feature seven lefties in their lineup. While Mariners starter Logan Gilbert has a decent overall ERA, he has been less effective at home (3.99 ERA) and has allowed 8 earned runs in his last three starts. The Athletics' bullpen is also a major concern, ranking last in ERA and being heavily taxed recently. Given these pitching vulnerabilities and bullpen issues, the total of 7 seems too low, making the Over a strong play.

picks.game: Nashville SC @ New York City FC
picks.rationale: Nashville SC is in exceptional form, winning their last four MLS matches and scoring 12 goals in that span. In contrast, New York City FC is struggling, winless in their last five games with two losses and three draws. NYCFC is also severely hampered by a lengthy injury list, missing key players such as Talles Magno, Maxi Moralez, and Keaton Parks. The line movement also indicates sharp money coming in on Nashville, as their odds have shortened from +156 to +130.
